notes.title: Preparing for the 1.0
notes.content:
[p]Hey, there has been some silence from communication but this is not because of abandoning development! The development has been focused on getting things ready to leave the Early Access during August. Here is a sneak peek of things coming in the final version.[/p][h2]12 New animals[/h2][p]There will be the full list of the promised 30 animals, so that’s 12 more than the current version. Not all of them will have a fancy new mechanic but there are some coming including ghost that can move through walls and fire elemental that sets fires around it. Of course the fire elemental would be alone without covering the other 3 basic elements of the fire, earth, water and air system, so they will be added too. Currently there are no tundra animals but the 1.0 update will include Yeti, Direwolf and Jotun to fill this emptiness.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/551c5717892193338c263d96a1d44c37d6b498aa.png"][/img][/p][h2]New stuff for guests[/h2][p]In the previous update guests got a lot of new buildings. In the next update they will get some more. There will be new toilets and stalls. New toilets come in new sizes, so you won’t have to only build tons of outhouses, maybe a couple of magical toilets will do the job. New stalls will include a special Potion stall, this stall will sell potions with magical effects. Guests can now forget all the animals they saw and explore the zoo completely new with a Potion of Forgetting or maybe they just buy a basic health potion as a drink.
[/p][p]Old stalls with each appearance will be combined into a slightly simpler system where each stall type has 4 different buildings, 1 for each material. Then each stall can select the colour appearance of textures of wood and stone with a new style selector. This greatly reduces the amount of different building buttons in the stall menu. As a side effect old saves using the old stalls not load all of the stalls, so be prepared to start a new save with new version.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/105f4f0c6a031c87e41c1160979d5788d0520d94.png"][/img][/p][h2]Environments[/h2][p]The lake environment is missing most of the props currently. This will be fixed with new assets for trees, rocks and water plants in the next update. Also other environments will have new stuff like volcanic and graveyard environments.[/p][p][/p][h2]Addressing things that wont be in 1.0[/h2][p]There are tons of things that won’t be coming in the final version that players suggested but wont be included for various reasons.[/p][list][*][p]Breeding of animals. Implementing this with the current resources is sadly not viable, most animals would require both female and male variants in addition of the child variant. Instead the development has been trying to focus on getting more different and interesting animals out.[/p][/*][*][p]Campaign mode. The challenge system is meant to be the simple way to give goals and guide the player. In a campaign mode there could be more story elements included and maybe some special limits/effects included. Maybe in a possible future expansion/update something like this could be added.[/p][/*][*][p]Variety of guests. There was an early plan for guest “classes” as in D&D, etc. Some rogue guests could steal gold or brave warriors would attack escaped animals. This was scrapped to focus on the current features and expanding them, (plus the AI is buggy enough as it is)[/p][/*][*][p]Modding support. This is a thing that will be seriously looked into after the release. Technically the game systems might allow for easy addition of buildable things into the game.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]That is all for now, if you have any small suggestion or feedback don’t leave them in comments or in the Steam forums![/p]

notes.title: Achievements and map settings devlog
notes.content:
Here is a short devlog about upcoming achievements and new starting settings.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

Achievements are coming in the next patch. They will be mostly simple milestones your Zoo reaches, such as X amount of animals, or more special and tied to different mechanics. They are not meant to be mandatory to unlock things are small thing to point out what has happened. 

Achievements are zoo specific and will be supporting Steam achievements. Some achievements can be disabled, depending on the play mode you play on. All achievements are unlockable on “normal play” so when using challenges, research and non “free-form” gold start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/56d976fe89dc2e9d2f64c092c26ea638eca88f5c.png[/img]

[h2]Map settings[/h2]

To make the map feel more alive than just a blank canvas, a new map options will be added. With these you can select what kind of map you will start on. Will it be a empty desert with some rocks or a lush jungle? The map is then generated randomly filling it with the desired props. 

These new map settings come with ready made preset for each environment but you can tune it to your taste. Maybe you want full desert or empty jungle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/c94072c9c0be2b1ee8f20b95705b4e19a081a0a6.png[/img]

Thats all, feel free to leave a comment for any suggestion or feedback!

notes.title: Worker devlog
notes.content:
Here is a short devlog about changes coming to workers.

In the current version workers will do all the jobs they encounter. In the next update there will be an option to toggle certain job types from the workers so you can have dedicated cleaners and so on. Each tier of workers have also limited skills which limit the types of work they can do. Low tier works can do only simple tasks while high tier workers can do everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/ce12671bed450d8097924566c47d0177a22d2eb7.png[/img]

The following workers are the only ones currently planned to be in the game and they will be in the next patch.

Goblins

Theses are the basic cheap starting workers. Goblins know the basic jobs and keep the zoo running. Though, they can not do the more advanced jobs, like capturing escaped animals alive. While working in staffed buildings, goblins lower the revenue of that building by stealing some of the profits.

Skeletons

Skeletons require no wage but instead require some mana. They are meant to be super cheap but bad workers. They mainly can clean the zoo or staff buildings. Skeletons also lower slightly happiness of the guests who see them, since seeing undead too close is not that fun for most.

Humans

Basic workers with a medium wage. Humans can do all things that zoo requires. While staffed in buildings they will slightly increase the revenue of the building they work at.

Mage

Mages are the high-tier workers and require high wage. Mages can do their work from a small range away by casting spell and do it fast. While in buildings they increase the revenue and boost slightly guests happiness.

notes.title: Fire devlog
notes.content:
Since fire breathing is an iconic part of dragons and fire magic common in fantasy, it has been a important feature to include. A simple fire mechanic is going to be in the next patch and here some more info about it.

Most things that feel to be able to burn will do so. This includes wooden walls, trees, most animals and guests. Fire deals damage to animals and guests, so burning guests will try to run away from the zoo. Buildings and other static things will break if they burn for too long, this allows for fiery animals to escape from unprotected wooden enclosures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/5f746c34ff6c2c62193dc54a0a2b287b8c3a0fb5.png[/img]

To combat new fire mechanics workers now try to prioritize important jobs such as extinguishing fires and run while doing them. There is also new crystal of fire that prevents fires in its range so you can still hold dragon in wooden enclosure. 

With fire comes 2 new spells to play around with it. More important spell is the rain spell, which can be used to extinguish fires in large area (it might have some other logical effects too).  Fire spell is meant to be a more of a fun spell and allows hurling fire into your zoo. So if you want to cause some chaos you are allowed to.

notes.title: Challenge update
notes.content:
A new update with many new things including challenges, water, trash and new UI look.

[h2]Main content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenges
[*] Trash and poops
[*] Water
[*] New terrains and environments
[*] New UI look
[/list]

[h2]Challenges[/h2]

Challenges are optional milestones which give you gold rewards once completed. They are meant to guide and give ideas what you could add to the zoo next. There are couple of challenge types; build a specific things or have some kind of animals in you zoo. For example: have flying animals in your zoo. Challenges are offered at start of each day and you can decline or accept them. 

[h2]Water[/h2]

There is new lake environment and water terrain. Normal items cannot be place into the water. Only lake environment animals can enter into the water and need ramps to do it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/8d67f10778f2b231daa31e7e35a9f4ffea58ed05.png[/img]
[h2]Trash and poops[/h2]

Guest now carry and trash items once they consume items that leave behind trash. If there is no trash container nearby, the guest will drop the trash into the ground. Trash containers have a capacity, witch can be infinite if you use the new crystal of void or magical trash containers.

Animals now leave behind poops or other trash items, which workers will clean up. If the enclosure becomes too messy, the animals will start to become unhappy.

[h2]Alpine environment[/h2]

Alpine is a mountainy environment for animals that like in high altitudes. Griffin, harpy and pegasus now like the alpine environment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/7f295ab962d139e188263c4514a7a16eccbbb253.png[/img]
[h2]Tundra environment[/h2]

The snow environment is now in game but there is no animals yet for it, so you can just use the new props for decoration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/7de8a0639f261bb5f1f68d2d992535ef12934f37.png[/img]
[h2]New UI look[/h2]

There is now new UI style, leave feedback how if you like or dislike it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/5f60fc9344e24fb2655ef0b2052f6c201569041c.png[/img]
[h2]Other improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] More starting options
[*] Changed pylon models
[*] Tuned tutorial with the new challenges
[*] Lots of small changes to UI
[*] Soup stall and rock bench
[*] Each environment terrain now has 3 different terrains
[*] AI destination setting should now be more consistent
[*] Tuned how animal’s enclosure status is calculated

notes.title: Trash and poop devlog
notes.content:
Here’s an another short devlog of upcoming new features: trash and poop.
[h2]Trash[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/9d57dd70a5020817bb6ebcc48f53060e95a72189.png[/img]

In the next update trash and trash containers are added to the game. When guest consume bought items, they will gain a trash item which they will try to throw away. If there is no suitable trash container nearby the guest will drop it on the ground and make the zoo messy. Workers will clean and empty trash containers as they see fit. The fantasy theme allows for different kinds of methods of keeping the zoo clean of trash. Maybe you want bottomless trash cans or have portal as the trash container which makes the trash someone else’s problem.

[h2]Poop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/d489330cebe8276c6ee292ecdf221024aa71f25a.png[/img]

Poop has been a planned and conflicting subject to be added into the game. Poop can be seen as a dirty and disgusting feature and many games choose to ignore it. As pooping is natural part of all real world animals its going to be in the game. Fantasy animals feature different kinds of beings which allows for interesting and funny questions, does this animal poop? Non naturalistic animals might have their unique trash items that they leave behind instead of generic poops. 

Poop mechanic was experimented with slimes and now most of the animals have some kind of poop/trash object that they will leave behind occasionally. Too dirty enclosures make the animals unhappy so workers need to clean up the mess regularly.

notes.title: Water environment devlog
notes.content:
Hey, here’s a short devlog about an upcoming feature to the game, water environment.
Water has been a little problematic feature to implement with all the possibilities of things to bug out. Despite this, the water environment is coming. Here is WIP image of what its going to look like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/17f8575e2caecac8a7453e1d177e4ca7b5c0bcc7.png[/img]

Animals that can swim, can enter and exit the water using ramps that are build on the edges of water. Some objects can be placed in water. Water is built similar to normal terrains which allows player to be more creative of shapes they want. Of course, you cannot build over preexisting objects, so you first need to clear the area you are going to be building. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/71e788263f6853d2ec0a304d6b8040cd47324731.png[/img]

Due to performance limitations of current system, there will only be one water type which is going to be reserved for water environment. This does not exclude the possibility of multiple styles or types of water  coming in future. The water environment is going to contain capricorn and any future swimming/water themed animals (at least hydra).

notes.title: Petrify update
notes.content:
A new major update is here, containing new magics, petrifying animals and more.
[h2]Main contents:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New effect of petrified
[*] Jungle environment
[*] Basilisk and Phoenix
[*] Moving tool changed from freeze spell to teleport spell
[*] Workers will now freeze escaped animals
[*] Settings menu expanded
[/list]
[h2]Petrified[/h2]
With the addition of basilisk comes a new status effect of petrified. Basilisks and cockatrices have a gaze that petrifies its target. To allow safe viewing of petrifying animals a new type of magical glass walls need to be used or the animals will petrify guests. Most animals can also be petrified alongside workers, so be sure that petrifying animals don’t escape. Petrify effect can be removed with the new Cure spell which also heals its target. Workers will also try to cure any petrified targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/b9b79061c9516441d552174386dfdd94476c7ac6.png[/img]
[h2]Freezing status effect[/h2]
The important feature of allowing workers to capture escaped animals is finally here. Workers will now freeze escaped animals witch health is low enough to be frozen. 
Players can freeze and unfreeze targets with the freeze spell. The old moving of objects is removed from the freeze and there is new Teleport spell for moving objects. 
[h2]Jungle[/h2]
New environment with new assets. Giant spider and cockatrice require now jungle environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/c46d18d454748e70eaebcc064c071756a90b9535.png[/img]
[h2]New animals[/h2]
Basilisks and phoenix are now in game. Basilisks petrify with their gaze and require desert environment. Phoenix requires volcanic environment and rebirth from ashes when they die.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/10463cb6f10f6eabe531a4c75c960aa96ab61b71.png[/img]
[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Setting menu is expanded with camera controls and rebinding of keys
[*] Dragon now requires pile of gold as sleeping place
[*] Added small meat and vegetables
[*] Bunch of new tooltips
[*] Reworked animal ai to new system
[*] Reworked guest ai to new system
[*] New spell visuals
[*] Improvements of UI
[*] Human workers are now under one button
[*] Reworked how pathfinding works with gates
[/list]

notes.title: Magic Update
notes.content:
New update that introduces Mana into the game. 
[h2]Mana[/h2]
Most magical things now require mana. Common tools such as delete, undo and freeze are classified as spell and require mana to be used.
Mana has base maximum storage and gain, these can be upgrade by crystals.
[h2]Crystals [/h2]
There are now 5 new crystals.
[list]
[*] Mana crystal, increase mana gain
[*] Mana storage crystal, increase max mana storage
[*] Crystal of bastion, increase strength of walls near it
[*] Crystal of speed, increases movement speed of everything near it.
[*] Crystal of miasma, emits miasma inside enclosure it is
[/list]
Effect crystals require constant flow of mana, or they will turn off.
There is minimum mana of 100, so you cant run completely out of mana, if you go under this value crystals will turn off until you are back safe value.

[h2]Other things[/h2]
[list]
[*] New icons for building menu
[*] New spell to toggle things you can see
[*] Gold tracker now has buttons to show different days
[*] More tooltips for things
[*] Rebuild worker AI to fix bugs (there might be still new ones)
[/list]

Leave a comment if you have any feedback or ideas on game!

notes.title: Mana System
notes.content:
This is first of series of regular devlogs on the development of Fantasy Zoo so you can know how the development is going and what to expect in future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/c53914c3af7db4030847aa6f96b031960a0dfc43.png[/img]

[h1]Mana system[/h1]
Mana has been a long planned feature of the game since there is heavy magical element. Plan is to have all magic elements to feature mana in some way. Mana is a simple resource that is passively gained by building mana crystals and its storage is limited by storage crystals. 

Magic crystal passively use mana and if mana starts to run out, random crystals start to go off to balance it. System is quite similar to usual electricity systems found in other games, if crystal gets mana its active and if not, its effect is disabled. This can lead to classic Jurasic Park experience where running out of mana can lead to rampaging animals in the zoo.

Mana is also meant to be used with different spells player can cast. All basic tools like delete or undo are classified as spells but these basic spells are cheap to use. More complex spells like mass moving objects are more expensive and are limited by mana storage to limit their excessive use.

[h2]New magic effects[/h2]
There are many ideas for new magic crystal effects, effects can be categorized by their effect area or their hit targets.
[list]
[*]Enclosure crystals, affect the whole enclosure they are in.
[*]Area crystals, affect area around them
[/list]
Each crystal has also different objects they can have effect on, wall strengthening crystals affect only walls and so on.

There are many planned effects, here are some of them coming in next patch:

[list]
[*] Crystal of bastion, increases strength of walls near it.
[*] Crystal of speed, increases movement speed of everything near it.
[*] Crystal of miasma, enclosure crystal that is required for undead beings.
[/list]

Leave a comment if you have anyfeedback or ideas on game!

notes.title: Research & worker update
notes.content:
[h1]Research & worker update [/h1]

This update focuses on new features for progression and money management. Of course, there are also 4 new animals which brings the animal count to 15. 
 
[h2]
Research tree 
[/h2]
There is now research tree for unlocking new things. Research tree will be expanded with future content updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/41b30d819a5d70173e454482b2a6b9ebc37a11f9.png[/img]

[h2]Staff [/h2]

Buildings now need to be staffed and different worker types have different effects to the building. You can choose to have unskilled goblins who steal some of the income but are cheap or have more qualified humans who charge more wage.  

Worker types also affect normal workers and there are plans to have more types with different effects, like mages.

notes.title: Take Flight Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42542810/aaa376659007f2e2a6c785d916c922e3bd6f9728.png[/img]
[h1]Take Flight Update[/h1]

[h2]New update with 2 new animals, modifications to previous animals and basic tutorial. [/h2]

Game development has been slow since launch, but most systems foundations are now at place. With tutorial objective system is ready for future challenges and crystal pylons are ready for future magical elements. Most of the user interface now support also localization.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
Added slimes and pegasus
Winged animals can now fly
Added magic crystal system that affects enclosure where it is, currently only crystal of grounding which prevents flight.
Added tutorial
Objects have now descriptions.
